user.title: Solar Sky Radar Setup
user.description: Configure your location (defaults to your Home Assistant home zone), regional coverage radius, satellite/radar sources, and optional NASA FIRMS Map Key.

data.radius_deg: Regional Coverage Radius (degrees, ~110 km per degree)
data.firms_map_key: NASA FIRMS Map Key (optional in Australia where DEA Hotspots is built in)
data.enable_dea_hotspots: Include Geoscience Australia DEA Bushfire Hotspots (Australia)
data.enable_bom_ftp: Prefer direct BOM Anonymous FTP GeoTIFF/JPG when TCP port 21 is open
